'''Sistros''' was an ancient [[Nouane (Allied Region)|Nouanese]] [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]]. One of the [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]], Sistros' controversial thought strongly influenced the early [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
===Life===
Along with [[Faya/Legends|Faya]], [[Yanjon/Legends|Yanjon]], and [[Braata/Legends|Braata]], Sistros was one of the [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]].<ref name="CL" /> The Four Sages of Dwartii hailed from the [[Dwartii system/Legends|Dwartii system]] in the [[Allied Region]] of [[Nouane (Allied Region)|Nouane]]. Renowned for its [[Library/Legends|libraries]] and philosophers, Nouanese ministers would often achieve positions of great power and influence in the early Galactic Republic.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The Four Sages of Dwartii were highly-influential but nonetheless controversial [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]]-lawgivers<ref name="CL" /> whose decrees were often viewed as coldly unsparing.<ref name="TEA" />

===Legacy===
During one of the periods of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] rule of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], a large statue of Sistros was created,<ref name="SWI95">{{InsiderCite|95|Set Piece}}</ref> forged from solid [[Neuranium/Legends|neuranium]]<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> with a [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] finish.<ref name="CL" /> By [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], it had come into the possession of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious.<ref name="Plagueis" /> When he became [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], the statue decorated [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|his private office's anteroom]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Concealed within the statue was a secret hollow space, which contained Palpatine's [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

Although the actions of Sistros and the other Sages were controversial,<ref name="CL" /> a small statuette of the ancient demagogue capped the [[Speaker's staff/Legends|ceremonial staff]] wielded by [[Vice Chair/Legends|Senate Speaker]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] during the last days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="ROSV">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the now defunct MMORPG ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', all four statues of the Sages of Dwartii could be collected. The in-game statue that was labeled as Sistros's depicted a man holding an open [[Book/Legends|book]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> However, Sistros' statue in both ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''<ref name="ROSV" /> and the bronze statues set "Sistros and Braata" produced by [[Sideshow Collectibles]] depicted a man with his hands folded in his sleeves.<ref name="SSC">{{WebCite|url=http://www.sideshowtoy.com/collectibles/product-archive/?sku=7232|text=Sistros and Braata: Secret Origins of the Sith|work=SideshowCollectibles.com|archiveurl=https://archive.is/6otEg}}</ref> [[Leland Chee]], administrator of the [[Holocron continuity database]] at [[Lucasfilm]], later stated that the Sideshow identification was correct<ref name="Twit">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/382980658861076480|[[Leland Chee]]|archivedate=20190722093252}}</ref> and that the Sistros statue was indeed the one with the folded hands and long sleeves.<ref name="Twit2">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/3840816051718799360|[[Leland Chee]]|nobackup=1}}</ref>
